issues.issue: Whether the claimant is a member of a particular social group (family members targeted by relatives over a land dispute) under s.96
issues.applicant_position: Family members targeted by relatives over a land dispute, without state protection, form a particular social group.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to intervene (letter of March 27, 2015).
issues.result_quote: the claimant has not established that he is a member of a particular social group in the sense of the definition of a

issues.issue: Whether voluntary returns to Haiti undermine the claimant's alleged fear of his relatives (s.97)
issues.applicant_position: Relatives will kill him over the property dispute if he returns to Haiti.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to intervene (letter of March 27, 2015).
issues.result_quote: These voluntary returns do not correspond with the behaviour of someone whose life is at risk.

issues.issue: Whether the long delay in leaving the US and in claiming asylum in Canada undermines the claimant's credibility on risk to life
issues.applicant_position: Stayed out of fear, did not know about refugee status, and hoped to regularize through a sponsorship before claiming.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to intervene (letter of March 27, 2015).
issues.result_quote: the claimant has not credibly established that his life is at risk in Haiti for the reasons he alleges

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces detention and cruel treatment on arrival in Haiti as a returnee with a criminal record (s.97)
issues.applicant_position: Would be detained on arrival in Haiti pending criminal record checks, in inhumane detention conditions.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to intervene (letter of March 27, 2015).
issues.result_quote: it does not constitute sufficient evidence to demonstrate, on the balance of probabilities, that the claimant faces a risk of detention upon return to Haiti

issues.issue: Whether the generalised kidnapping risk faced by people who lived abroad is a personal risk under s.97(1)(b)
issues.applicant_position: As a person who lived in the US and Canada he is prone to kidnapping in Haiti.
issues.respondent_position: Minister declined to intervene (letter of March 27, 2015).
issues.result_quote: section 97(1)(b) of the IRPA does not apply to the present case
